reviewNotes: Fuel columns are labelled "Up to 37" then "Fuel at 38" … "Fuel at 58". Imported as (n−1.00, n] THB/L brackets (e.g. 37.01–38.00 = "Fuel at 38"). Whether a label means "up to" or "from" that price is not stated in the source — confirm with the contract owner.
The PDF header quotes a reference fuel price of THB 36.69/L; it is shown for information and is not used for pricing.
6W steps are THB 50 per level while 4W steps are THB 15; both are exactly as printed.

reviewNotes: Source footer says "PAGE 3 OF 3" although only one page was supplied; page 1–2 of this set were not provided.
Vehicle is "Trailer + empty 40' container" over 214 km — not an ordinary 4W/6W vehicle class.

schedules.name: APL Pricing

reviewFlags: Irregular progression in the 6W schedule: steps are +150, +153, +156, +159 … growing each band (compounding-like), then the last band (50.01–51.00) is only +1 (THB 18,693 → 18,694). All values kept exactly as printed. Manual approval required before use.

reviewNotes: Source columns are labelled 0%…21% with fuel bands THB 29.01–30.00 … 50.01–51.00; the percentage is not applied — the printed amount is the rate.
